title: Here is my Economic simulation MMO game, ALPHA is live
author: FriendshipTime8506

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: How do you intend to monetize it if at all?

replies.author: FriendshipTime8506
replies.body: Well it’s to early to say right now, but initially there could be a mix of approaches. It will be freemium for sure, but there will be some exclusive nice to have consumable goods that players need but cannot buy on the game market, also exclusive skins for loadout, extended storage, etc. And probably I could place ads in some places. Will test what works once I get significant amount of players.

comments.author: Natural-Rich6
comments.body: Can you explain why not to put it to the app store?

replies.author: FriendshipTime8506
replies.body: I’ve designed a lot of native apps for my clients and saw where it comes after development is ready. Every time is it the same headache: you’re waiting 2 months for App Store compliance, they can refuse, never explain why. They can refuse once you make new release, without explanation. I’ve seen this frustration millions of time. Another thing, App Store doesn’t give enough analytics. In terms of monetization - App Store takes insane fees. So there is nothing better for early stage product than Progressive Web App - you just get a full freedom. But, once I get my first 1k players and if they ask for native apps, I’ll definitely make it.
